# PlotTrellis example project. Mouse mammary basal cells (Basal) and luminal progenitors (LP)
# from Milevskiy et al. 2023, Cell Genomics (GEO GSE227750), every data type, cut down to five
# genes (mm39): Eya2, Lrrfip1, Acot7, Dzip1 and Cxcl14. See README for the source of each file.
#
# To set up your own project, copy this file and change:
#   data_root      the folder your data files are in (relative to this file, or a full path)
#   gtf_path       your genome's GTF, GENCODE or Ensembl (relative to this file, or a full path)
#   orgdb          your species' OrgDb package, e.g. org.Hs.eg.db for human
#   genome_label   the UCSC name of your genome build, e.g. hg38
#   suggested_genes   optional: genes (names or Ensembl ids) the app's gene box suggests
#   before anything is typed
# then list one row per sample. Each column after colour is type:name, and each cell is a
# path relative to data_root (bw = bigWig, paired-end = splice junctions, quantdir = a Salmon
# output folder holding quant.sf, bed = peaks, hic = Hi-C).
# data_root: .
# gtf_path: annotation.gtf.gz
# orgdb: org.Mm.eg.db
# genome_label: mm39
# suggested_genes: Eya2, Lrrfip1, Acot7, Dzip1, Cxcl14
condition	colour	bw:RNA	paired-end:junctions	quantdir:salmon	bw:ATAC	bed:ATAC_peaks	bw:H3K36me3	bed:H3K36me3_peaks	bw:IgG	hic:HiC
Basal	#b31e1e	rna/Basal_RNA.bw	rna/Basal_junctions.bed	rna/Basal_salmon	atac/Basal_ATAC.bw	atac/Basal_ATAC_peaks.narrowPeak	cuttag/Basal_H3K36me3.bw	cuttag/Basal_H3K36me3_peaks.broadPeak	cuttag/Basal_IgG.bw	hic/Basal_HiC.mcool
LP	#4b7538	rna/LP_RNA.bw	rna/LP_junctions.bed	rna/LP_salmon	atac/LP_ATAC.bw	atac/LP_ATAC_peaks.narrowPeak	cuttag/LP_H3K36me3.bw	cuttag/LP_H3K36me3_peaks.broadPeak	cuttag/LP_IgG.bw	hic/LP_HiC.mcool
